question_b_fast_hook_headroom.answer_as_labeled: distribution n=9 green hook reals across 2 sessions (v20 n=6: 172-186; v21 n=3 at freeze: 160-197.6) + 2 tier-span points (185.85, 190.4): every observed point sits at <=32.9% of the 600s budget - a statement about OBSERVED POINTS ONLY, no forward stability implied (council-prompted precision). The v21 max (197.6, a re-pin commit while the game seat ran live) exceeds every v20 point by ~6%: ambient/session variance visible at n=2 sessions, another reason no trend is licensed. Selection note: the distribution is green-only by construction; the one red is reported above and cost the same ~3 min wall (a drift red is now cheap to hit - contrast the v19-era 3917s drift red). question_c_push_cost_at_693.span_law: total-hook = lfs check + suite-stage (coverage-on) + repo-wide warn-metric stages + hook overhead, every term non-negative, so total-hook >= suite-stage unconditionally (composition per the banked v19 hard_gate_map_verified block; the council's reversal scenario - LFS dominating - would only shrink the suite-stage bound further, strengthening the claim). v20 was a zero-new-exports sprint, so LFS had nothing new to transfer (negligible term), but the bound needs no such assumption. Cross-span comparisons stay bounded/directional only (pre-registered rule 4)
question_c_push_cost_at_693.expected_band_from_composition_model: v18 anchor 12311s + 25 logic-class tests added v18->v20 (~20-50s coverage-on per the banked class model) = ~12331-12361s; +/-3-6% noise band -> [11591, 13103]s
question_c_push_cost_at_693.observed_vs_expected: the v20 bound (<=11205s) sits ~3.3% BELOW the expected band's floor. The bound is ONE-SIDED: the true suite-stage miss is >=3.3% and its magnitude is unknowable from this carrier (the warn-metric stages' share is unmeasured). At n=1 the causes - band too narrow, ambient variance (the v19 precedent: -2.5% raw at identical count, same direction, inside band), or model midpoint too high - are indistinguishable and none is claimed. What the bound DOES license: the cost did not RISE (no growth-alarm signal at 693)
question_c_push_cost_at_693.v21_push_point: lands AFTER this file freezes by construction (the bank commit precedes the push); the push's time real + any hook-printed stage lines go to the close log and are inherited by v22 — the exact mechanism that carried v20's 186m45s
question_c_push_cost_at_693.answer_as_labeled: n=1 point per era with a span mismatch: only the bounded claim is licensed - v20's suite stage at 693 ran no slower than 11205s (below the composition-model band floor; one-sided, magnitude of the miss unknown), i.e. NO cost-growth signal v18->v20; push-timeout headroom >=48% on the total-hook span (observed point, no forward claim). The v17/v18 suite-stage growth (+1578s at +23 tests) remains explained by the banked composition model, not extrapolated
